headline: Thursday Pressers
deck: Vitaly Janelt banned for Brentford, with Yehor Yarmoliuk suspended alongside him
body: Vitaly Janelt is suspended for Brentford, a ban rather than an injury.

teamNews.line: Jannik Schuster has trained for several days after a disrupted week, while Vitaly Janelt and Yehor Yarmoliuk both serve bans.

men.name: Jannik Schuster
men.note: back from a disrupted week; training the last few days

quote.text: But he’s been back training the last few days, so he’s back to himself, more or less.

teamNews.line: Saša Lukić is ruled out for Ipswich Town.
Four men are missing for Coventry City, and an ankle problem is now holding up Josh Eccles's rehab after his calf injury cleared.

men.name: Josh Eccles
men.note: ankle; calf cleared, not yet on the grass

quote.text: The ankle has been an annoyance, really, for all of us because Josh’s calf injury has cleared up and now the ankle’s a bit of a problem, so it’s affecting his rehab and his recovery. He’s still not with us out on the grass yet.

teamNews.line: Antoine Semenyo is ruled out with a knee injury, and Haaland is the only one of four fully available, with Nunes, Kovacic and O’Reilly waiting on Thursday afternoon's session.

quote.text: Still a doubt. For sure, Erling is the only one 100% available, and the other three we need to wait for today’s session.
